about.title: About NANDESK
about.lead: A platform for the Belém markets that answers a simple question: which market and which stall has this?

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Vendors at Ver-o-Peso and Feira da 25 sell products found only in Pará, but they barely show up online. People looking for Brazil nuts, jambu or herbal baths do not know where to go, and tourists also face a language barrier.

sections.title: How the data gets here
sections.body: Vendors do not need to use the app. Community collaborators receive tasks, go to the market, check in by GPS, talk to the vendor and send photos and prices. A moderator reviews each submission before it goes live, and every piece of information shows when it was checked.

sections.title: How collaborators earn
sections.body: Every approved submission earns a commission, recorded in the collaborator's statement. Payouts are made outside the platform, by PIX or cash, by the program team. NANDESK does not process online payments: sales keep happening at the stall, as they always have.

sections.title: Offline
sections.body: Markets are crowded and the signal comes and goes. Install the app, save the markets and check stalls and prices even without a connection. Collaborators' submissions wait in a queue and go out by themselves when the signal returns.

sections.title: Who makes it
sections.body: An academic project from the Computer Science program at UNAMA, built by Adriano Pinheiro da Silva, Leonardo Farias de Souza and Victor Santiago dos Santos Abreu. Open source under the MIT license.

vendors.title: I am a vendor
vendors.lead: Your stall appears on NANDESK only with your permission, and you can ask to leave at any time.

sections.title: What is shown
sections.body: The stall number and name, the market and section, the products you sell and, if you want, the reference price and a photo of the stall. Your name only appears if you authorize it separately.

sections.title: Who updates it
sections.body: Community collaborators visit your stall, check the products with you and send the information. You do not need an account, a phone or spare time.

sections.title: How to leave
sections.body: Talk to any collaborator, to the moderators, or write to {{email}}. The stall disappears from the platform right away, and photos are deleted within 30 days.

sections.title: Payment
sections.body: NANDESK charges you nothing and does not broker sales. Customers keep buying directly at your stall, the way you already get paid.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Draft for legal review before the public launch. We collect the minimum needed, for the shortest time possible.

sections.title: Visitors
sections.body: You do not need an account to search and see stalls. Searches are logged without IP and without user, only for the indicators. We do not use third-party trackers or analytics.

sections.title: Collaborators
sections.body: We keep name, email, phone (optional) and the PIX key, encrypted and visible only to admins when making a payout, with access logged. Location is used only at check-in; the coordinates are deleted after 90 days.

sections.title: Photos
sections.body: Photos must not show identifiable people without consent. Metadata (including GPS) is removed on upload. Photos from approved submissions are deleted after 90 days; rejected ones after 30.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: In your profile you can export your data as JSON and ask to delete your account. Questions about personal data: {{email}}.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: Draft for review before the public launch. Version 2026-10.

sections.title: The platform
sections.body: NANDESK shows information about stalls at the Belém markets kept by the community. Prices are for reference and may vary at the stall.

sections.title: Collaborators
sections.body: To accept tasks you must be 18 or older, give true information and be at the market when checking in. Fake submissions, reused photos or photos of people without consent are rejected and lower your reputation.

sections.title: Commissions
sections.body: Commissions are credited only when the submission is approved. The amount is shown before you accept. Payouts are made outside the platform by the program team, from a balance of R$ 10.00.

sections.title: Vendors
sections.body: No stall is published without the vendor's consent, and vendors can ask for removal at any time.
